boxes.title: 23rd CWG, Glasgow
items: **23 July - 2 Aug 2026**; only **10 sports** (no shooting, wrestling, hockey); replaced **Victoria**
⚠ **Braille medals** first time; first CWG under **King Charles III**
India **4th**: **39** medals (**13-17-9**); Australia top (**171**)
**Mirabai Chanu**: flag bearer + ==India's first gold, 3rd straight CWG gold==
**Tejaswin Shankar**: first decathlon medal; **Asmita Dey**, **Harsh Singh**: first judo golds
Next: ==**Ahmedabad 2030**== (centenary)
